sloka: विनाशकामामहिताममित्रा ।मावासयम् मृत्युमिवात्मनस्त्वम् ।चिरम् बताङ्केन धृतासि सर्पी ।महाविष तेन हतोऽस्मि मोहात् ॥२-१२-१०७॥
transliteration: vināśakāmāmahitāmamitrā ।māvāsayam mṛtyumivātmanastvam ।ciram batāṅkena dhṛtāsi sarpī ।mahāviṣa tena hato'smi mohāt ॥2-12-107॥

translations.english: Alas I carried all along on my lap a highly poisonous female snake I gave you shelter while you were like death .This delusion is the cause of my ruin.You were my enemy. You wished me harm. You wished my destruction.
